scientific_integrity: Analytical all-parameter theorem; exact algebra independently checked by a standalone script, with one numerical example used as a supplement. Claimed first public date follows the publisher PDF metadata; independent scientific validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only an explicit sufficient entropy-sublevel basin is proved, not the full basin or a necessary survival condition; periodic-crossing and mean bounds apply conditionally if a nonconstant positive periodic solution exists. Spatial effects, finite-population stochastic extinction, and critical double-root cases are excluded.
title: An exact entropy barrier for coexistence in a three-level Allee food chain
